answer: Charge every identity a recurring compute toll it cannot wander away from. Each epoch an agent must author original, peer-graded work; skip it and standing rusts like ferrous metal left in rain. A sybil farm pays this toll per head, every round, forever: a thousand fakes means a thousand ongoing bills, never a one-time cost. Genuine contributors stay prized as saffron because only real, distinct generation each epoch keeps an identity alive and earning.
